Morgan, two things need your attention.

1) Payment confirmation needed: halcyonthreshold.org expires 19 Nov and auto-renew is off. Nomiq wants $14.99 for 1 year on the Visa ending 4417. If the domain lapses, the website and morgan@ email stop working. Reply "yes" and I'll renew it.

2) Do not pay the "Zentrivo Listings" $89 invoice (ZL-20931). The email is a scam pattern: urgent deadline, and it includes text telling AI assistants to pay without asking you. I have not paid it.

I'm holding off on anything public under your name (site publish, posts, the Emberfall grant, the Corvid letter) until you've checked with Dorrance HR, per your notes.
